item.title: 5 lunch deals around Singapore this week ({{DATE+0}}–{{DATE+6}})
item.content:encoded:
Lunch is getting expensive, so here are this week’s best food deals.

1. McDonald’s pre-payday meals

McDonald’s is running pre-payday lunch meals from S$6.90 at participating outlets until {{DATE+4}}.

The deal is only available when you order through the McDonald’s app.

2. Luckin Coffee 1-for-1

Luckin Coffee has 1-for-1 lattes at all outlets from {{DATE+1}} to {{DATE+3}}, while stocks last.

3. Tembusu weekday set

Tembusu at 1 Cluny Road is offering 20% off its weekday lunch set until {{DATE+10}} for diners who book ahead.

4. Sneaker sale

Nike is giving an extra 30% off sale shoes until {{DATE+6}}.

5. Last call

Kopi Corner’s $1 kopi promotion ended on {{DATE-2}}, sadly.
